title: 노래방에서: 왜 늦었어? 일 끝내느라고!
objective: Use V-느라고 to say why something went wrong (verb stem, no past tense, same subject).
summary: Friends at a noraebang explain why they were late or missed something.
setting: A noraebang on a weekday evening. Minsu and Eric book a room, then Jieun arrives late from work.

task.title: Use -느라고 and karaoke words
task.line: Follow each instruction. Use the verb stem with -느라고 and the words from the dialogue.

words.meaning: karaoke room (a private room you rent with friends)
words.exampleMeaning: After the team dinner, we went to a karaoke room.

words.meaning: to queue up a song (at karaoke)
words.exampleMeaning: Please queue up a song for me, too.
I search for the singer's name with the remote.

words.meaning: song number (in the karaoke book or system)
words.exampleMeaning: If you don't know the song number, search by title.

words.meaning: score (the machine gives one after each song)
words.exampleMeaning: Wow, I got a score of 100!

words.meaning: to lose your voice; to get hoarse
words.exampleMeaning: I shouted a lot, so my voice got hoarse.

words.meaning: to add more time (to the room)
words.exampleMeaning: It was so fun that we added 30 minutes.

words.meaning: to be frazzled; to be too busy to think
words.exampleMeaning: I was so busy this morning that I couldn't think straight.

dialogue.korean: 미안, 늦었지? 회사에서 일 끝내느라고 늦었어.
dialogue.meaning: Sorry, I'm late, right? I was late because I was finishing work at the office.

dialogue.korean: 괜찮아. 빨리 노래 예약해. 리모컨 여기 있어.
dialogue.meaning: It's fine. Queue up a song quickly. The remote is here.

dialogue.korean: 잠깐만, 노래 번호 찾느라고 정신이 없어. 아, 찾았다!
dialogue.meaning: Wait, I'm all over the place looking for the song number. Oh, found it!

dialogue.korean: 에릭 씨, 노래 진짜 잘한다! 점수도 95점이네.
dialogue.meaning: Eric, you sing really well! Your score is 95, too.

dialogue.korean: 사실 어제 혼자 연습하느라고 잠을 못 잤어.
dialogue.meaning: Actually, I couldn't sleep last night because I was practicing alone.

exercises: Fill in the blank with 듣다 + -느라고: 친구 노래를 ____ 전화를 못 받았어.
Is the sentence natural? Write Natural or Not natural: ① 노래방에 가느라고 기분이 좋아요. ② 탬버린을 치느라고 노래를 못 불렀어요.
Join the two sentences into one with -느라고: 노래를 골랐어요. + 친구 노래를 못 들었어요.
Fill in each blank with one word from the word list: ① 노래를 너무 많이 불러서 목이 ____. ② 10분밖에 안 남았어요. 30분 ____할까요? ③ 리모컨으로 제 노래도 ____해 주세요.
Answer in Korean with 버스를 기다리다 + -느라고. Your friend asks: 왜 이렇게 늦었어?
answers: ① Not natural. The result is good, not a problem (better: 노래방에 가서 기분이 좋아요.) ② Natural
노래를 고르느라고 친구 노래를 못 들었어요. (고르느라)
① 쉬었어요 ② 추가 ③ 예약
